criticalRules.claim: All selected sword subtypes support light cleave and looping ground light combos.
Aggressive airborne heavy is supported; full energy was an erroneous gate fixed in October 2023 and recharge delay must start.
2019 aggressive aerial-light target lunge and lightweight ground/aerial dash are positive historical evidence, not calibrated current constants.
Do not apply the 2020 general aerial-energy exception universally: preview explicitly admits sword-specific exceptions, and aggressive later starts recharge delay.
No verified grounded-only prohibition for caster or vortex was found in these sources.
Eager Edge/Valiant Charge special lunge and search-angle changes are perk-specific and cannot calibrate the five baseline frames.

authoredUnknowns: Exact target acquisition range, search cone and lunge displacement/speed/caps.
Cleave arc, volume, vertical tolerance, target cap, falloff and per-target damage.
Light/air combo sequence length and reset conditions; damage-event count per current frame.
Attack startup/contact/recovery, cancel windows, gravity/momentum and air-action limits.
Per-frame aerial heavy shape, energy exceptions and grounded-only prohibitions except positive claims listed in the matrix.
evidenceBoundary: A still can show pose, orientation, terrain-relative displacement or visible effects. It cannot reveal unshown input, grounded server flag, hitbox, damage arc, or exact travel in world units.
